name: LanGuard-Scanner
description: LanGuard Scanner (Scheduler) is the network discovery engine for LanGuard. It performs automated Layer 2 ARP sweeps, service scans, port monitoring, Wake-on-LAN actions, and local Docker container inventorying. NOTE: This is the scanner/scheduler component of the LanGuard stack. It requires host networking and privileged mode to execute raw socket ARP scans. Must share the same /data directory and SECRET_KEY with LanGuard-Backend . Credits & Support: - Created by Yossi Hillali ( GitHub ). Support the developer on PayPal . - The donation link below specifically supports the maintenance of this Unraid template repository.
